summary: Full backend + frontend regression after new features (audio preview, prices, mobile pre-payment, admin uploads). Backend: 30/30 pytest tests PASS (test_bigsmedia_api.py 18 + test_beats.py 7 + new test_uploads_and_prices.py 5). Verified: seeded /api/beats returns 3 beats each with non-empty FCFA price; POST /api/upload rejects unauth (401) and accepts multipart with Bearer token then returns {path}; GET /api/files/{path} returns exact bytes publicly with correct content-type; POST /api/admin/beats persists price + preview_url and both fields appear in public /api/beats; POST /api/admin/portfolio creates a project that appears in public /api/portfolio. Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport): Beats tab lists exactly 3 seeded instrumentales with title, genre·tempo, price (15/20/25 000 FCFA), 'Extrait bientôt disponible' + disabled play button on the 3 (no preview), and 'Commander · <price>' button. Tapping Commander opens Paiement with order summary card (beat title + price) + MyNita/Amanata selector + reception number +227 96 55 81 93. 'Payer & confirmer sur WhatsApp' opens wa.me/22796558193 with URL-encoded message containing beat title, price and selected method (verified with method=Amanata: 'Bonjour Big S, je commande l'instrumentale "Afro Zouk Love Vol. 1" (15 000 FCFA). Paiement via Amanata au +227 96 55 81 93.'). Generic /paiement (no beat) hides order summary, shows lead text 'Réglez votre acompte…' and same reception number. Admin dashboard: login OK (admin@bigsmedia.com / BigS2026!Admin), Réalisations form exposes 'Importer une image' (testID project-pick-image) + URL fallback field (project-image-input) — created a TEST_ project via URL fallback and it appeared in the admin list; Instrumentales form exposes Prix field + 'Importer un extrait (mp3)' (testID beat-pick-audio) — created a TEST_ beat with price 10 000 FCFA and it appeared in the public Beats tab with the price. Test data cleaned up via admin DELETE. No red screens, no new console errors. Success: backend 100%, frontend 100%.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/upload correctly gated by get_current_admin, writes to APP_NAME/uploads/admin/<uuid>.<ext>, and returns 402/502 mapped errors — clean.
server.py /api/files/{path:path} uses path converter so nested keys work; init_storage retries on 503 in get_object — good resilience.
beats.tsx correctly routes Commander -> /paiement with title+price params; useAudioPlayer receives null source when no preview so no illegal fetch; setAudioModeAsync in useEffect avoids web crash.
paiement.tsx builds the wa.me message differently for order vs generic and URL-encodes via openWhatsApp; verified end-to-end.

admin/index.tsx uploads via uploadFile (multipart with Blob on web) and stores the returned storage path in image_url / preview_url; mediaUrl resolves paths to /api/files/... for the Beats/Portfolio queries. Dual query invalidation keeps admin + public lists in sync.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_UI_ project + one TEST_UI_Beat_ beat created via admin UI and cleaned up via admin DELETE endpoints. Backend seed of 3 beats (with prices) + 4 projects verified present.

WhatsApp opens go through window.open on web preview; intercept with a page.add_init_script overriding window.open to capture URLs. Admin creds: admin@bigsmedia.com / BigS2026!Admin.
